title: Main 10v10 debate loop (Epic 6, orchestration §3.2)
prompt:
Implement the debate loop for ROUNDS rounds: Pro turn, controller drift-check (+nudge), Con turn (must rebut), controller drift-check (+nudge). Exactly 10 Pro + 10 Con messages. Log every message/tool_call/nudge.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: MAIN LOOP of the debate (orchestration §3.2) — NOT the timeout/retry wrapper (6.4) or verdict/closing discussion (6.5/6.8). Split into four small files (each <= 150 CODE lines, split not compress). engine/loop.py: run_debate_loop(setup, config, *, gatekeeper=None, run_id, runs_dir) -> DebateResult — for round in 1..config.rounds runs Pro turn -> controller drift-check (+nudge) -> Con turn (must rebut Pro) -> controller drift-check (+nudge); tracks each side's last message so Con rebuts Pro's latest and Pro (from round 2) rebuts Con's last; assembles a DebateResult(transcript, nudges, totals=CostTotals.from_messages(...)) with verdict=None and closing_discussion=[] left as 6.5/6.8 seams. engine/turn.py: run_debate_turn(...) injects the per-turn side anchor (and, when an opponent message exists, the sanitised adversarial relay via relay_opponent_turn) into the debater's OWN context, generates via the gatekeeper, enforce_word_limit (trim to exactly max_words + log a 'system' violation), appends the assistant reply, and logs one 'message' event (run_id/round/agent + word_count + tokens/latency). engine/drift.py: run_drift_check(...) calls assess_drift -> on capture builds a nudge (is_debate_turn=False, NOT a debate turn) and logs a 'nudge' event; returns None when on-side. engine/gatekeeper_proto.py: a Gatekeeper Protocol capturing the minimal execute(...) surface so the loop depends on the shape (tests inject a spy that counts calls; the real ApiGatekeeper satisfies it structurally). GATEKEEPER: every debater model call routes through gatekeeper.execute(agent.run_sync, message_history=ctx.message_history(), service='anthropic'); absent injection the loop builds a default ApiGatekeeper from load_rate_limit_config(). The 6.4 timeout/retry wraps exactly at that execute call (clean seam, no behaviour change). pydantic-ai (v1.104) note confirmed against the installed version: run_sync is called with only message_history (its trailing 'user' turn — the just-injected anchor/relay — is the live prompt; verified no user_prompt needed); AgentRunResult.usage is now a PROPERTY (input_tokens/output_tokens fold into DebateMessage + CostTotals). New constants LOOP_MESSAGE_EVENT_TYPE='message', LOOP_NUDGE_EVENT_TYPE='nudge', LOOP_NUDGE_LOG_AGENT='controller', LOOP_MODEL_SERVICE='anthropic' (no hard-coded labels/caps; rounds+max_words from DebateConfig). TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_debate_loop.py (7 tests: rounds Pro+Con alternating with right round numbers; over-limit trim + violation logged; conceding Pro -> drift capture + nudge recorded & logged, NOT counted as a turn; every message logged in order; every model call routes through a spy gatekeeper (calls == rounds*2); default gatekeeper when none injected; Con's context receives Pro's framed message ('Rebut it')), watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'run_debate_loop'), then implemented. Re-exports: engine/__init__ + _engine_public.py shim now export run_debate_loop + Gatekeeper (split, not compress). Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check = All checks passed; ruff format --check = 129 files already formatted; mypy = Success, no issues in 129 source files; pytest --cov = 499 passed, total 100% (loop/turn/drift/gatekeeper_proto all 100%, >=85); check_line_limit pass; secret_scan pass.
